answer: Each agent must stake a refundable saffron-denominated bond locked for three epochs and link it to a unique hardware-attested jade identity. On proven Sybil detection the bond is slashed and the identity is permanently banned from the knoll of active validators. A farm of N clones therefore loses N separate bonds plus the multi-epoch lock time, making mass identity creation capital- and time-prohibitive compared with a single honest agent that risks only one bond.
